goals: Universally give every BGE-bound physical state the active Iris shader material classification of its authoritative BGE-projected canonical state when that canonical state is mapped, without altering the shader pack.

Depend on BGE being present and exposing the authoritative BgeMaterialBindings canonical-binding/state-projection API, rather than on a BGE release string, registry-name parsing, or a derived-block inventory.
Preserve shader-pack authority: an explicit physical BGE material or layer assignment wins over parent inheritance.
scope: Provide a client-only Fabric bridge for BGE's canonical-binding capability/API contract and Iris 1.11.2+mc26.2 that augments completed Iris material and layer maps at their narrow RETURN seams.

Canary 3 applies the same universal authoritative canonical-parent rule to every BgeMaterialBindings binding, preserving BGE's state-specific canonical projection for material IDs and using the binding's canonical block for Iris layer.* entries.
Retain Translucent Glass and BGE × CTM as adjacent diagnostic context only; this project does not own their rendering or Continuity behavior.

exclusions: Do not modify, copy into the artifact, redistribute, or patch the Complementary archive, originals/, Iris JAR, or saved shader configuration.
Do not modify BGE core or BGE × CTM; BGE retains canonical binding/state projection and native render setup, while BGE × CTM retains Continuity behavior.

No hard-coded Complementary material IDs, BGE-derived registry-name parsing, generated per-derived-block ID table, shader-pack parser replacement, material-category allowlist or denylist, or override of an explicit shader-pack physical mapping.

dependencies.requirement: Present with BgeMaterialBindings.all() and Binding#physicalBlock(), #canonicalMaterial(), and #canonicalState(BlockState)
dependencies.reason: The bridge consumes BGE's authoritative canonical-binding/state-projection API and fails closed if that API shape is unavailable; it has no BGE release-number predicate.
BGE × CTM remains adjacent Continuity context and is not an implementation dependency for Iris material inheritance.
The private bridge targets Iris BlockMaterialMapping's exact completed-map descriptors and fail-closes for every other Iris version or Iris absence.
Exact read-only shader-pack audit target for material and layer behavior.
Useful clear-glass texture and CTM diagnostic only; it is not a shader-material provider.
Java 25 baseline used for the clean Canary 3 compile and tests.
Tracked Workbench Gradle wrapper baseline used for Canary 3.

state.milestone: Canary 3 is an ACTIVE client-only BGE canonical-binding API/Iris 1.11.2 bridge. For every authoritative BgeMaterialBindings physical state it augments Iris's completed state material map only when that BGE-projected canonical state is mapped; its block-wide layer fallback follows the same canonical-parent rule. Explicit physical pack entries always win. BGE release strings do not control activation; the required API shape does. The exact retained artifact passed clean static validation against current BGE C80 and awaits owner-directed in-game testing.

exceptions.predicate: present BgeMaterialBindings canonical-binding API; no release-number predicate
exceptions.reason: Canary 3 invokes only BgeMaterialBindings.all() and Binding#physicalBlock(), #canonicalMaterial(), and #canonicalState(BlockState); its mixin plugin fails closed when that API shape is unavailable without comparing a BGE version string.
regression_evidence: Clean Canary 3 verification uses current BGE C80 SHA-256 5bc7c23a3724a1e20bc2142459f33d2a45a19295c27d40197c5fc48d6e43b0fc, requires BgeMaterialBindings.class, proves C80 exposes each consumed method, and runs focused universal-inheritance coverage.

exceptions.reason: The private RETURN mixin is descriptor-coupled to Iris 1.11.2; its plugin declines every other version and Iris absence.
regression_evidence: Static audit records the exact BlockMaterialMapping material and layer RETURN descriptors, and focused tests prove Iris's exact guard, universal completed-map fallback precedence, and no hard-coded shader IDs or parent-category policy.

current.summary: Universally inherits active Iris canonical shader material and layer classifications for every authoritative BGE binding that exposes the required canonical-binding API.
